MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The short Ethernet cable feels like a useful next purchase because it could complete a wired connection with my recent USB Ethernet adapter.",
    "The USB WiFi adapter and DVI-to-HDMI cable connect to needs I have had before, though I would only buy them if I needed a replacement or that exact display connection."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The 24-port switch assumes a much larger networking setup than my individual adapters suggest.",
    "The drive mounting kit, SATA cables and memory module require a specific upgrade project and compatible hardware that I have not indicated I have.",
    "The protection plan, label tape and laptop stand do not follow from a current device purchase, label maker need or laptop setup need."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying a few computer accessories seems to have been taken as interest in almost any computer upgrade or accessory.",
    "My past cable and adapter purchases seem to have been treated as ongoing demand for more cables and adapters, regardless of the connections they serve."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent Ethernet adapter makes a cable that completes that connection more relevant than equipment for a much larger network.",
    "I buy infrequently for specific practical needs; related products alone rarely give me a reason to buy now.",
    "Exact connectors, operating-system support and hardware compatibility matter before I would choose another adapter, display cable or memory module."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my interest in practical connectivity accessories but stretch it into upgrade projects and equipment needs I have not shown."
}
